name: Takasugi Shinsaku
source:
He has dangerous ideas, and is willing to do anything to achieve his goals. There are rumors that he and Kirisato are old friends, but no one knows more than that. He may get closer to the protagonist in order to use her.

[Edited from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
